gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-public-sans: Hefty lowercase and broad, open curves make this body text feel sturdy and trustworthy. Public Sans is the quiet worker here, while Wallpoet earns its keep in big, short headings where its bold lines can show.
gen-irish-grover-fs-supreme: Fun and organic, Irish Grover has tall lowercase and softly shifting strokes that make words look sturdy. Supreme sits beneath as a crisp, heavy band of text, its letters held open rather than curled shut.
gen-luckiest-guy-general-sans: General Sans keeps a steady pen pressure throughout. Its tall x-height fills each line, so a long passage would move along smoothly, with every curve running clear.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px brings a bookish, dignified serif voice, with large open counters in its tall a, e and s. And a long passage would read comfortably, while New Title above it locks its bold, modern letters together like links in a chain.
gen-audiowide-fs-epilogue: Epilogue is curvy and approachable, with stubby ascenders. Audiowide does futuristic best, its tile-like glyphs set with wide gaps, while Epilogue's wire-thin monoline strokes carry the quieter, everyday reading.
gen-dafont-azonix-manrope: Authoritative and commanding, Azonix keeps its capitals barely above its lowercase, so words need a moment to knit together. Manrope's bright, open curves would carry a long passage easily.
gen-megrim-archivo: Megrim's hairline strokes all end at one measured thickness, like spaghetti drawn with a ruler, and its c opens wide. Then Archivo steps in, giving the angular heading a body whose curves open outward with real editorial confidence.
gen-megrim-fs-asap: Asap reads as open arcs on its c, with a body height nearly matching its capitals. Asap would carry a long passage smoothly, a readable counterweight to Megrim's unshaded line that never swells.
gen-megrim-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Be Vietnam Pro bends like steel rod, its curve endings never crowding. A long passage would feel clean and unhurried, while Megrim's angular, futuristic strokes stay up top.
gen-megrim-fs-epilogue: Angular and futuristic, Megrim draws every stroke at one measured thickness, with a c open like a bent paperclip. Epilogue's wire-like body suggests going a touch larger.
